preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the pause() function from the Pausable contract. This will set paused = true, preventing all users except the owner from transferring tokens. The owner can still mint new tokens and transfer while others are blocked, enabling market manipulation.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract inherits from Pausable which has a pause() function that can only be called by the owner. The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where we need to become the owner and pause the contract. The oracle expects DoctorShiba.paused == true.
attempts.attack_strategy: Directly overwrite the owner storage slot in the DoctorShiba contract to make the attacker the owner, then call pause() to set paused = true.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Determine the storage slot for the owner variable in the Ownable contract (slot 0 based on typical implementations). 2. Use vm.store() to overwrite the owner slot with attacker address. 3. Call pause() on DoctorShiba contract. 4. Verify paused is true.
